72616d736f72617175657301 description: A batch of Ragman's supplies went missing at Ground Zero. Head to the area, recover the cargo, and look into the sniper who has been unusually active nearby.
72616d736f72617175657304: Find out what happened to the supply crate
72616d736f72617175657301 successMessageT: Got the cargo back? Good work, the rest of your pay is in. As for that 'sniper'... watch yourself.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7261 description: SORA needs a stable long-term base. Head back to your hideout and use the USB stick she gave you to contact her.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7265: Use the USB stick in your hideout to contact SORA
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7261 successMessageT: I keep my word - Ragman's people have already picked up the cargo. Keep the software. Stay in touch.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7271 description: SORA spotted a squad in black gear meeting with a local scav boss. Her idea of an investigation is simple: beat them up first, ask questions while you're at it. Clear out 7 Scavs on Interchange.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7271 successMessageT: Not bad. I've got a read on the men in black now... Terra Group. Payment's in - stay away from them.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7282 description: You offered SORA a section of your expanding hideout. Raise your Hideout Management skill to level 10 to prove the new home is in good hands, then wait for her to arrive.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7282 successMessageT: The new place will do nicely - I've already settled in. Pleasure doing business... roommate.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7286 description: SORA wants to put together a simple table and needs building materials. Gather 10 of them (bolts, nuts, screws, wires - all count). The Idea mall on Interchange is said to be full of them. She says she has something for you afterwards.
5043a1ce90726f6a536f7286 successMessageT: Materials counted - the table goes up tonight. That thing I promised you... you'll get it soon.
